text:
Alex P: quick async check-in — small update on gateway / routing / rate limits
Maria G: what I did: rolled canary for the new routing policy (route-by-model-version) to 10% last night, noticed 429s from a small cohort
Jamal: blocker: not sure if 429s were client bursts or gateway throttling. grabbed request ids + kv-cache metrics, capturing logs now. @deploy-bot posted the deploy id
Sophie L: looked at auth metrics — token validation latency spiked ~150ms for ~3 mins, causing token bucket drains on a few routes
Kevin: temporary mitigation: raised burst limit for route /v1/generate (policy rp-824) to 30/s at 00:20 UTC — 429s dropped after the change
Alex P: next steps: 1) Jam to add smoothing for per-client bursts, 2) Sophie to backfill auth latency telemetry, 3) Maria to open PR for policy tweak and keep canary at 10% until validated
Maria G: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/6213 — tiny change to routing policy JSON, tagging for quick review
Jamal: pinging @Alex P for review. I'll add a JMeter scenario to reproduce the burst pattern and attach results
Sophie L: blocker for me: need access to auth-prod logs (retention svc). filing infra-logs request now — if not approved by EOD I'll add synthetic instrumentation in the proxy
Alex P: I'll review the PR this morning and help Jam with the load test script. If we see regression in canary, we'll revert to rp-legacy
Maria G: tl;dr — policy tweak + monitoring. keep canary at 10% until smoothing validated; rollback plan in place
Kevin: added a console note and new alert: route-429 > 0.5% over 5m -> page oncall (so we won't miss spikes)
deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T23:12Z succeeded to canary (hash: a1f4c6)
Alex P: anything else? :thumbsup:
Maria G: none from me
Jamal: starting the JMeter job in ~30m, will post results here
Sophie L: infra ticket created (INF-3421), including access request for auth logs
Alex P: thanks all — I'll update this thread with PR review + test results once done
